title: Ordinary uniform ranks for iterated Picard direct images
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be flat, proper and locally of finite presentation [def-pc-scheme], $E$ a finite locally free module [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], $g:T\to S$, and assume $R(f,E,g)$ [def-sc-picard-universal-rank-match]. Let $F=E$ or $E^\vee$, $p=\operatorname{pr}_2:X\times_S T\to T$, $G=\operatorname{pr}_1^*F$ and $M=p_*G$, using tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and ordinary pushforward [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Then $M$ is finite locally free. Moreover, every $s\in T$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ and $r\in\mathbb N$ such that for every $k:Y\to U$, $p_{k\iota,*}v_{k\iota}^*G$ is finite locally free of rank $r$, where $p_{k\iota},v_{k\iota}$ are the projections of $(X\times_S T)\times_T Y$. This only compares ordinary objects and asserts no invertibility of any canonical map.

proof.text: Apply universal rank matching to any h:Tprime to T and choose the E or dual direct-image rank witness according to hF. Tensor pullback along an open inclusion is isomorphic to Mathlib pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints. The neighbourhoods cover Tprime, so finite local freeness descends by Modules.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isOpenImmersion. Taking h=id gives finite local freeness of M.

At s retain the identity-test neighbourhood U and its rank r for the appropriate direct image. For k:Y to U, pullback preserves rank r and tensor-pullback composition identifies its pullback with P=(k followed by U inclusion)^*M. Associativity of the pullback squares and equivalence along the canonical fibre-product isomorphism identify Q, the iterated ordinary image, with the composite direct image. The preceding local argument makes Q finite locally free.

The existing Picard stalk-finrank comparison gives finrank Q_y=finrank P_y=r at every y. To conclude fixed rank r for Q, choose any finite local frame near y with index I. Open restriction preserves stalk finrank: the restriction-stalk additive isomorphism is semilinear over the inverse structure-ring stalk isomorphism, as checked on germs; Mathlib rank_eq_of_equiv_equiv preserves its rank. The fixed-rank stalk theorem applied to the restricted frame gives card I=r. Reindex each frame by Fin r and glue with isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_of_restrict_iso_free. Empty Y is handled by the empty covering, and r=0 by the empty frame.

lean.statement:
theorem picardRankMatch_ordinary_ranks {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (g : T ⟶ S)
    (hR : PicardUniversalRankMatch f E g)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : F = E ∨ F = Modules.dual E) :
    let G := (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F
    let M := (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f g)).obj G
    M.IsFiniteLocallyFree ∧
      ∀ s : T, ∃ U : T.Opens, s ∈ U ∧ ∃ r : ℕ,
        ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (k : Y ⟶ U.toScheme),
          SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
            ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) (k ≫ U.ι))).obj
              ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) (k ≫ U.ι))).obj G))
            r
